title: I made a detective game in 4 days for the Epic MegaJam where you can see special forces cameras and action
author: NoCupcake5185
selftext:
Hey! This is LAST FOOTAGE, my entry for the Epic MegaJam (theme: "Director's Cut"), made in 4 days. It's also my first game in Unreal Engine, made with AI

An officer died during a night raid on a cabin in the woods. The report is already written: a scared kid with a gun shot him. Case closed, but is that right? 

You're an Internal Affairs detective. You plug into the dead officer's bodycam and replay the team's last minutes frame by frame: pause, rewind, zoom in/out, look around inside the footage, scan people and evidence, and jump into another officer's camera when he's in view. The question is who really fired the shot.

It's rough around the edges, but I'm planning to keep going with it and turn it into a proper demo! If you want ask me anything, I will answer + more info you can find on Itch

Link: https://game-over-interactive.itch.io/last-footage

Have fun!
